original_ai_output.title_zh: 阿布贾法院放宽商人David Nwokorie保释条件，此前因涉前警察副总监之女案件被羁押数月
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 阿布贾联邦高等法院法官Rita Ofili-Ajumogobia于2026年11月3日裁定，放宽商人David Nwokorie的保释条件，将原需一名上校及以上军衔军官作担保的要求，改为公共服务部门12级及以上可信担保人。Nwokorie因一起据称与其前女友、退休警察副总监Hilary Opara之女Genevieve Opara关系破裂有关的网络犯罪案件，已在Kuje惩教中心羁押七个月。他否认相关指控，并指控警方无证逮捕、蒙眼戴铐及在押期间未获适当医疗；其律师还向联邦司法部提交请愿，指控退休副总监Opara试图影响Kuje监狱人员对其施以酷刑。上述指控尚未获证实。

key_facts.fact: 阿布贾联邦高等法院放宽David Nwokorie的保释条件
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Federal High Court in Abuja has relaxed the stringent bail conditions imposed on David Nwokorie

key_facts.fact: Nwokorie因网络犯罪案件在Kuje惩教中心羁押七个月
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: an Abuja businessman who has spent seven months at the Kuje Correctional Centre over a cybercrime case

key_facts.fact: 原保释条件要求一名上校及以上军衔军官作担保，后改为公共服务12级及以上可信担保人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: replaced the requirement for a senior military officer with that of a credible surety not below Grade Level 12 in the public service

key_facts.fact: Nwokorie于2025年4月9日因包括敲诈、网络跟踪、网络欺凌、勒索和威胁生命等指控被捕
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The businessman was arrested on April 9, 2025, over allegations including extortion, cyberstalking, cyberbullying, blackmail and threats to life

key_facts.fact: Nwokorie否认指控，并指控警方无证逮捕、蒙眼戴铐及剥夺律师会见
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He alleged that police officers arrested him without a warrant, handcuffed and blindfolded him, denied him access to a lawyer

key_facts.fact: 其律师提交请愿，指控退休副总监Opara试图影响Kuje监狱人员对其施以酷刑
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: accused Opara of allegedly attempting to procure the cooperation of officers at the custodial centre to punish him

uncertainties: 针对Nwokorie的刑事指控尚未经法院判决，其本人否认全部指控
